items.title: Coherent (COHR) Starts Sampling 300mm Silicon Carbide Substrates For AI Infrastructure
items.summary: Coherent (NYSE:COHR) has begun customer sampling of its advanced 300mm high thermal conductivity silicon carbide substrates for AI infrastructure. The new 300mm substrates are aimed at AI data centers and high performance computing systems that face rising demands for thermal management and material scalability.
